header: Step 2: Turn on audit logs in OpenSearch Dashboards
content:
After you enable audit logs in the OpenSearch Service console, you must also enable them in
OpenSearch Dashboards and conﬁgure them to match your needs.
1.
Open OpenSearch Dashboards and choose Security from the left side menu.
2.
Choose Audit logs.
3.
Choose Enable audit logging.
The Dashboards UI oﬀers full control of audit log settings under General settings and Compliance
settings. For a description of all conﬁguration options, see Audit log settings.
